facts.text: The hotel is steps from the Duomo di Milano and the adjacent Piazza del Duomo.
facts.excerpt: Stay steps from Duomo di Milano and the adjacent Piazza del Duomo

facts.text: Mio Lab is the hotel's cocktail bar, a space overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
facts.excerpt: Mio Lab is the renowned cocktail bar at Park Hyatt Milano, an elegant space overlooking the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.

facts.text: La Cupola Lounge sits beneath a nine-meter-tall glass cupola.
facts.excerpt: the stunning La Cupola Lounge welcomes guests to unwind at all hours of the day beneath its nine-meter-tall glass cupola

facts.text: La Cupola is the hotel's all-day dining outlet.
facts.excerpt: La Cupola is the all-day dining outlet of the hotel

facts.text: The gastronomic restaurant Pellico 3 Milano was redesigned in 2022 and is led by chef Guido Paternollo.
facts.excerpt: Redesigned in 2022, the restaurant carries on a concept of lightness and balance under the guidance of a new young chef, Guido Paternollo.

facts.text: Chef Guido Paternollo's cooking at Pellico 3 Milano draws on places and traditions of the Mediterranean area.
facts.excerpt: his culinary philosophy draws inspiration from different places and traditions of the Mediterranean area

facts.text: AQVAM Spa powered by Beautick offers massages, a whirlpool and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt: Discover pure relaxation at AQVAM Spa powered by Beautick, your oasis in the heart of Milan. Indulge in exclusive massages, unwind in the whirlpool and steam rooms

facts.text: The spa is on the lower floor of the hotel and has three treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: makes its home in the lower floor of the hotel, where it has three treatment rooms

facts.text: The Terrace Suites, Montenapoleone Suite and Duomo Suite have panoramic terraces overlooking the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: its Terrace Suites, Montenapoleone Suite and Duomo Suite stand out for their exclusive and evocative panoramic terraces overlooking the city skyline

facts.text: The Duomo Suite has a private terrace with a hot tub and views of the Duomo Cathedral.
facts.excerpt: Step onto the private terrace, complete with a hot tub, and admire breathtaking views of the Duomo Cathedral.

facts.text: The rooms' neutral color palette takes inspiration from the Duomo Cathedral.
facts.excerpt: the neutral color palette creates a unique connection taking inspiration from the Duomo Cathedral

facts.text: The Montenapoleone Suite has a central double-sided fireplace framed in bronze.
facts.excerpt: includes a central double-sided fireplace framed in bronze

facts.text: The toiletries carry a signature scent created for the hotel by Florentine perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi.
facts.excerpt: toiletries with a new signature scent created for the hotel by the Florentine perfumer Lorenzo Villoresi

facts.text: The hotel occupies an 18th-century palazzo.
facts.excerpt: The property, which takes up residence in an 18th-century palazzo

facts.text: Five signature suites were designed by architect Flaviano Capriotti.
facts.excerpt: five new signature suites designed by the architect Flaviano Capriotti

facts.text: Marble used throughout the property was sourced from Italian quarries.
facts.excerpt: from black-and-white Breccia Medicea to emerald Verde Alpi, all of it sourced from Italian quarries

facts.text: In spring and summer Mio Lab extends to an outdoor patio called Dehors.
facts.excerpt: In the spring summer, the space extends to a patio outside, called Dehors

facts.text: Mio Lab offers an experience on the Americano, Negroni and Negroni Sbagliato with live demonstration and tasting.
facts.excerpt: Discover the stories, techniques and refined interpretations behind the Americano, Negroni and Negroni Sbagliato through live demonstration, tasting and expert insight.

facts.text: The hotel is off the Duomo stop on the Metro.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is also off the Duomo stop on the Metro

facts.text: Parking is in an off-site indoor garage with valet service.
facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Milan is pleased to offer indoor parking at an off-site parking garage for guests and their visitors.

facts.text: Milan charges a daily congestion charge for vehicles in the city center on weekdays.
facts.excerpt: Milan City Authorities introduced a daily congestion charge of €7.50 per vehicle traveling within the city center Monday through Friday

facts.text: Since May 12, 2025, a Limited Traffic Zone applies in the Quadrilatero della Moda area.
facts.excerpt: effective May 12, 2025, the City of Milan has introduced a Limited Traffic Zone (ZTL) within the renowned Quadrilatero della Moda area.

facts.text: Dogs are accepted only in rooms from the Deluxe category upward.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are accepted only in the rooms and only in categories from DELUXE upward

facts.text: Standard rooms can be a tight squeeze for three or more; junior suites and up suit families.
facts.excerpt: Standard rooms might be a tight squeeze for groups of three or more, but everything from a junior suite and up can accommodate families well.

facts.text: The spa has a few stairs to get to the jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: the spa has a few stairs to get to the jacuzzi
